question: The world is ending in 48 hours. One person can stop it. Who do you actually trust with that call?

options.text: Dr. House. He'll be right and rude about it.
options.sub: Feelings are a distraction. Results are the point.

options.text: Ted Lasso. He'll get everyone in the room.
options.sub: You can't save the world if no one believes in you.

question: Your partner walks in the door visibly wrecked. Before they say a word, you:

options.text: Run a quick mental timeline of their day.
options.sub: If I can figure out what happened, I can help faster.

options.text: Put your phone down and wait.
options.sub: They'll tell me when they're ready. My job is to be here.

question: Your best friend sends you the first draft of their business plan. There's a fatal flaw. You:

options.sub: If I don't say it, who will? That's what real love looks like.

options.text: Ask what kind of feedback they need.
options.sub: Support and honesty aren't the same thing. I need to know which one I'm being asked for.
